author: bardic-inspiration
name: Lingering Dread
summary: Leaves a creature shaken, damaging it each time it flinches.

stats.effect: Choose a creature within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d6 Psychic damage and gaining the Frightened condition on a failed save. At the start of each of its turns it takes 1d6 Psychic damage and repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.
